supplementary_notes: No hardware command, ROS hardware worker, CAN operation, serial operation, motor enable, Flash write or EEPROM write was performed for this evidence set.
The GO continuous torque rating remains unknown; 0.6015625 N*m is a software guard and 3.2/4.07 N*m are actual rotor-side feedback observations, not continuous-rating authority.

The gravity-node to Router to GO software feedforward chain is connected, but the frozen gravity_control.yaml has continuous_rotor_limits_authoritative=false; therefore Router issues no real POSITION gravity authority and Tff remains zero.
GO stable arrival requires endpoint residence inside 0.5 degree for at least 0.5 s and 50 valid frames; drift revokes arrival and absence of stable arrival at 90 s latches domain BRAKE.

GO/J6 exact v1.3 trajectories entering >=55 C are not independently q/dq-derated: they latch to GO BRAKE or verified J6 DISABLED and require release, cooldown, a higher epoch, next-cycle rearm and a fresh preview; legacy profile/HOLD retains dynamic derating.
GO and J6 validate thermal_limits.yaml SHA256 1926264805858f62fffc9360ef0c9d4d7f8a7e232e171105450769d493ff5467 before hardware open; GO returns thermal_state_by_motor plus a top-level domain state.
Immediate GO BRAKE response telemetry is committed atomically; without a confirmed response the per-motor mode remains unknown and brake_observed=false.

The planned and actual MuJoCo previews own independent MjData and dedicated single-thread background renderers with latest-request coalescing; exact trajectory construction and request serialization also run off the Qt thread with stale-generation rejection.

Offline validation passed: colcon build for 2 packages; colcon test 578 tests; pytest aggregate 863 tests plus 86 subtests; C++ -Wall -Wextra -Werror; GO SERIAL_OPENED=NO and J6 CAN_OPENED=NO dry-runs.
Powered acceptance rows intentionally contain null measurements rather than fabricated values.
